articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN or "First Horizon") has named Elizabeth Adler Treasury Management Sales Officer for the New Orleans market. "We are excited to have Elizabeth on the Treasury Management Sales team in New Orleans," said Tony Adams, Gulf States Regional President for First Horizon Bank. "Her commitment to building strong relationships and delivering exceptional service will enhance how we serve our clients and communities across the region." "Elizabeth has a strong understanding of the financial needs of businesses within this market and knows how to translate those needs into customized solutions," said Marcy Sasser, Senior Vice President of Treasury Management for Louisiana at First Horizon Bank. "Her collaborative approach and dedication to service excellence are an ideal fit for this role." Adler brings more than 30 years of banking and financial services experience to her new role. articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") today announced it is working alongside Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Galveston-Houston and AltCap to implement an innovative financing solution to build a new 60,000-square-foot facility that will significantly improve access to food and other services for low-income Houstonians. The new Family Opportunity Center in north Houston will leverage New Markets Tax Credits (NMTC) provided by First Horizon Bank and the Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) AltCap. Slated to open its doors in 2028, the Family Opportunity Center will feature a market-style food pantry, thrift store, and access to the nonprofit's services, including mental health counseling, parenting classes, rental assistance and job readiness resources.
